candidate_merges.message: Separate channel update validation with aspire update --dry-run (#22207) ## Description Users should be able to apply a channel update without first requiring its dependency graph to restore. This separates applying a .NET channel update from validating it: normal updates selected through an option or Aspire configuration propose and apply confirmed changes without a validation restore, while `--dry-run` only validates and restores the original source files afterward.
